Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> I'm working on a PDF version of all existing cards, including the latest cardtext. It won't be available soon though, as I'm working on getting the art of each card.
>
If you're changing the card, that's potentially a problem. The RTR says:

- every proxy card must be a color-copy of the original card, on standard paper

Amended Photoshopped frankencards aren't a "color-copy of the original card".

That is not to say that such cards wouldn't be useful. But the Rules Team Ruling doesn't allow for them. Why it doesn't allow for them, only Pascal can clarify, I guess.
